title: Wall St notches monthly declines on AI, tariff, geopolitical worries
title_zh: 华尔街因人工智能、关税和地缘政治担忧而月度下跌

title: Earnings live: Block mass layoffs earn Wall Street's approval, Duolingo shares plunge
title_zh: 财报直播：大规模裁员获得华尔街认可，Duolingo 股价暴跌
summary: The S&P 500 was on track for double-digit earnings growth, with more than half of companies having reported Q4 results so far.
summary_zh: 标准普尔 500 指数有望实现两位数的盈利增长，迄今为止已有超过一半的公司公布了第四季度业绩。

title: CoreWeave suffers worst rout in six months over spending fears
title_zh: CoreWeave 因支出担忧而遭受六个月来最严重的挫败
summary: Analysts had estimated about 72 cents on average, according to data compiled by Bloomberg.  The company, an operator of AI data centers, also said that 2026 capital spending will be $30 billion to $35 billion — a bigger figure than analysts anticipated.
summary_zh: 根据彭博社汇编的数据，分析师平均估计约为 72 美分。  该公司是人工智能数据中心的运营商，还表示，2026 年的资本支出将达到 300 亿至 350 亿美元，这个数字比分析师预期的要高。

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq fall to end volatile month as AI worries buffet markets
title_zh: 今日股市：道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数、纳斯达克指数下跌，结束动荡的月份，因人工智能担忧自助市场
summary: The prospects for AI to sustain build-out spending and to harm legacy industries continue to be front of mind for Wall Street.
summary_zh: 人工智能维持扩建支出和损害传统产业的前景仍然是华尔街关注的首要问题。

title: Coinbase exec says crypto 'corrections' are simple math, not a catastrophe
title_zh: Coinbase 高管表示加密货币“修正”是简单的数学，而不是灾难
summary: Coinbase's John D'Agostino explains catalysts that will fuel crypto's next move.
summary_zh: Coinbase 的 John D'Agostino 解释了推动加密货币下一步发展的催化剂。

title: A look at Warren Buffett's final moves as Berkshire CEO
title_zh: 沃伦·巴菲特作为伯克希尔首席执行官的最后举动
summary: Berkshire Hathaway (BRK-B, BRK-A) will release fourth quarter earnings results on Saturday.
summary_zh: 伯克希尔哈撒韦公司（BRK-B，BRK-A）将于周六发布第四季度盈利结果。

title: Xiaomi launches safety advisory committee after EV accidents in China
title_zh: 小米在中国电动汽车事故后成立安全咨询委员会
summary: BEIJING, Feb 27 () - Chinese electric vehicle maker Xiaomi said on Friday that it will set up a committee of advisers to assess the ‌safety of its cars, as it moves to combat rising criticism over ‌a recent spate of accidents.
summary_zh: 北京，2 月 27 日 - 中国电动汽车制造商小米周五表示，将成立一个顾问委员会来评估其汽车的安全性，以应对最近发生的一系列事故引起的日益增长的批评。

title: Nvidia will remain the bellwether of AI, analyst explains
title_zh: 分析师解释说，英伟达仍将是人工智能领域的领头羊
summary: After Nvidia's (NVDA) overwhelmingly positive fourth quarter earnings still weren't enough to impress Wall Street investors, is the chipmaking giant still a bellwether for markets (^DJI, ^IXIC, ^GSPC) and the AI trade? Stifel applied technology analyst Ruben Roy and D.A.
summary_zh: 英伟达（NVDA）第四季度的压倒性盈利仍不足以打动华尔街投资者，这家芯片制造巨头是否仍然是市场（^DJI、^IXIC、^GSPC）和人工智能行业的领头羊？ Stifel 应用技术分析师 Ruben Roy 和 D.A.
